answer: An identity earns its seat through validator attestation of a remote chain head, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. Cloning 679 keys multiplies the price 679-fold: 74690 POA locked, or 9506 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. Trust the delta of the check, count the meadow of the cost, and read the willow of the history before any answer is graded. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
